label: ANALYTIC closed-form check on SYNTHETIC toy inputs for theory:dis-parton-model. Not a published benchmark: no published F_L value was read for this profile. The toy densities and alpha_s values are invented test inputs, not fits and not a statement about any nucleon.
density_form: number density f(x) = sum_k N_k x^a_k (1 - x)^b_k, entries [N_k, a_k, b_k]; b_k integer so the closed form is exact
alpha_s_note: TOY alpha_s values attached to the Q^2 labels; not run from any reference value. The toy densities are not evolved, so Q^2 enters only through these numbers.
